t01-silicon.brief: Launch video for MIRA-1, a 3nm AI chip shipping Q3. Engineering audience. Make it feel like a blueprint, not an ad.
t01-silicon.strategy: engineering schematic: wireframe chip over perspective grid, mono spec callouts, torus seal

t02-press.brief: Tell the story of Gutenberg's printing press in Mainz, 1440 — a history-channel short.
t02-press.strategy: letterpress: parchment, spring-stamp type blocks, ruled folio finale

t03-descent.brief: Take viewers down through ocean zones, 200m to 4000m. A science short, awe first.
t03-descent.strategy: continuous vertical dive: upward drift, dying light, rising particle density

t04-morning.brief: Product film for the Kama pour-over coffee set. Slow, quiet, premium. Three words.
t04-morning.strategy: whitespace luxury: one word per act, near-static motion, steam only

t05-snowball.brief: Explain compound interest so a teenager feels it. A finance short.
t05-snowball.strategy: data-as-protagonist: the exponential curve performs, type annotates

t06-diwali.brief: A Diwali greeting: one flame, a rangoli, then celebration.
t06-diwali.strategy: light ritual: flame flicker, counter-rotating kolam geometry, darkness as canvas

t07-kyoto.brief: Kyoto in autumn teaser: approach a torii gate, pass through it, arrive at a temple at sunset.
t07-kyoto.strategy: parallax journey: three depths at three speeds, push-through gate

t08-vaccine.brief: Explain how vaccines train the immune system as a friendly cellular chase. An education short.
t08-vaccine.strategy: animated diagram: motionPath antibody pursuit, staged pops, pastel lab clarity

t09-entropy.brief: An abstract short on entropy: show order visibly losing to chaos.
t09-entropy.strategy: system decay: stagger cascades, heat color binding, order as subject

t10-keeper.brief: A three-shot micro-story: a lighthouse keeper keeps the light through storm into dawn.
t10-keeper.strategy: cinematic vignette chapters: sweeping beam choreography, title-card chapters

t11-marathon.brief: Marathon hype reel: kilometer 41, the wall, the surge, the finish tape. 2:09:41.
t11-marathon.strategy: diagonal energy: tilted world, strobing numerals, speed-line barrages

t12-ramen.brief: A ramen recipe in three steps: vessel, broth and noodles, toppings. End hungry.
t12-ramen.strategy: top-down assembly: concentric construction, spring-set toppings, steam
